content.text: can you please tell me exactly how many users are assigned to the agent russomichelle_47
I'll help you find how many users are assigned to agent russomichelle_47. Let me pull up the manual to find the right function for checking agent-user assignments.{{READ:hierarchy_management}}

I see that `traverse_hierarchy` can show me the downline for an agent, but it returns the actual account details rather than just a count. Since you asked for the exact count of users assigned to russomichelle_47, let me check if there's a reporting function that can give me aggregated counts more directly.{{READ:aggregation_reporting}}

Perfect! I found the right function. The `generate_aggregation_report` with `metric: "count"` and `target_ancestor_id` set to "russomichelle_47" will give me the exact count of users assigned to this agent. I'll also need to filter by `type: "user"` to count only users (not other agents or admins in the downline).{{TOOL:generate_aggregation_report}}

The agent **russomichelle_47** has **0 users** assigned to them.

This means the agent currently has no direct user assignments in the hierarchy.
Let me check how many users are assigned to agent wross_10 using the same aggregation report function.{{READ:aggregation_reporting}}
Let me check how many users are assigned to agent wross_10.{{TOOL:generate_aggregation_report}}

The agent **wross_10** also has **0 users** assigned to them.

Both russomichelle_47 and wross_10 currently have no user assignments in the hierarchy.
